Net margin is net income divided by revenue. I use net income attributable to Chevron for Q1 2024 and total revenues and other income as the revenue base.

Net income attributable to Chevron was $5,501M. The sales and other operating revenues figure is $46,580M, and total revenues and other income is $48,716M.

The two possible bases give:
- On sales and other operating revenues: 5,501 / 46,580 = 11.81%.
- On total revenues and other income: 5,501 / 48,716 = 11.29%.

Total revenues and other income is the standard "Revenues" line on this statement, so I use it. The net income figure attributable to Chevron is the more common choice for net margin.

Net margin = 5,501 / 48,716 = 11.29%.
